name: s2-smoke
title: S2 smoke
description: Short checkable S2 tasks: arithmetic, facts, instruction following, translation, JSON mode, thinking, vision and 2k-token recall. Pass/fail plus speed.

messages.content: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only.
What is the capital of Australia? One word.
Reply with exactly the word pong and nothing else.
Translate to Spanish: 'The meeting has been moved to Thursday afternoon.'
Extract the person's name and age as JSON with keys name and age: 'Maria is 34 years old and lives in Lima.'
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much is the ball?

content.text: This image has two halves. Name the color of the left half, then the right half.
